notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
📢 Patch Notes of playtest version of game 20.06.2025
🆕 ADDED
nuclear strike
🎲 Randomized player eye variants
🚽 "Toilet Monster" encounter — defeat it for loot or get flushed
🧠 UI descriptions for all artifact effects
🔍 New artifact: Magnifier
🧭 New artifact: Pocket Compass (teleports you to the train)
🧩 Level modifiers for unique runs: extra traps, monsters, loot, fences/crates — even nuclear blasts
🛠️ Level scan function added to the workbench
📝 Playtest feedback survey restored

---

🔁 CHANGED
👂 Monsters can now hear you!
🧠 Pursuit AI overhauled: if a monster loses you, it goes to the last place it saw/heard you, waits, then resumes patrol
🎯 Hit registration on monsters reworked for better consistency
⛽ Starting fuel reduced to 20%; each player now starts with a gas can
🎲 Roguelike balance update: after Day 2, spawns are fully random — loot, enemy count (0–20), bunker size, etc.
🕴️ Jumping is no longer tied to stamina — jump as much as you want

---

🛠️ FIXED
📘 Tutorial errors
🎒 Inventory and item pickup bugs
🧟‍♂️ Monsters walking on ceilings or getting stuck on invisible walls
🚪 Missing exit-door bug
🛠️ Crowbar failing to break crates/barricades
📦 Item pickup/drop animations not working for clients
🔊 Incorrect volume for item detection sounds

notes.title: # Patch Notes – May 17, 2025
notes.content:
# Patch Notes – May 17, 2025

## Added
- Two new artifacts in the bunker:  
  - **The Speedboot**: increases the movement speed of all players within a 10 m radius by 150%, but deals damage over time to its wearer.  
  - **The Shrinker**: lets you shrink and squeeze into tight spots (those spots aren’t implemented yet—coming in a future update).  
- Adjustable mouse sensitivity and FPS‐limit settings.  
- Monsters can now trigger mines when they’re chasing you.  
- A brand-new room added to the bunker.  
- Game version check: you can no longer join sessions across mismatched builds (e.g. demo → playtest or vice versa), which previously froze players on the crafting screen due to version errors.

## Changed
- Slightly rebalanced item spawn rates in the bunker.  
- Disabled saving until there’s at least 2+ hours of content available.  
- Overhauled all bunker lighting to realistic volumetric lighting.

## Fixed
- Dead‐chat icons now display correctly.  
- HUD no longer shows in spectator mode.  
- Resolved Steam‐icon/nickname fetching errors that caused multiple bugs.  
- In-game menu is now clickable.  
- Players no longer glow after encountering the doll.  
- Corrected player‐icon scaling on the life-status monitor.  
- Plus dozens of networking and code fixes that resolved various other issues.

## In Development
- Facial animations on player models  
- New bunker: an abandoned psychiatric hospital  
- Random events (storm, nuclear-bomb launch)  
- More humorous artifacts, crafting items, and train upgrades (extra carriage already built)  
- Monster visual overhaul  
- Greater randomness for replay variety—so each run feels different, artifact combinations drive new coop-survival strategies and deliver fun, unique gameplay.
